description: Optional desktop applications that can be audited, prevented from launching automatically, or explicitly uninstalled.

apps.name: glazewm
apps.description: Third-party tiling window manager. Native Windows Snap remains available without it.
apps.warning: Custom Alt-based tiling shortcuts will be removed; use Win+Arrow or Snap layouts instead.

apps.name: zebar
apps.description: Retired custom-bar runtime. The project uses the native Explorer taskbar.
apps.warning: Only the retired custom bar is removed; Explorer remains the taskbar and shell.

apps.name: workstation-hotkeys
apps.description: Custom Win/Alt shortcuts formerly used with GlazeWM. Native Windows shortcuts work without it.
apps.warning: This uninstalls AutoHotkey for the current user. Do not select it if you use other AutoHotkey scripts.

apps.name: command-palette
apps.description: Optional launcher bound to Win+Alt+Space. Native Start and Search remain available.
apps.warning: Win+Alt+Space will no longer open Command Palette; Win and Win+S remain native.

apps.name: powertoys
apps.description: Optional Windows utility suite. It is not required by the native workstation profile.
apps.warning: All PowerToys utilities, including FancyZones and Keyboard Manager, will be removed.

apps.name: overwolf
apps.description: Game overlay platform used by apps such as Mobalytics.
apps.warning: Mobalytics is an Overwolf app and may stop working or be removed with the platform.

apps.name: mobalytics
apps.warning: Game overlays, match data, and companion features provided by Mobalytics will be removed.
